idea.method: The existing FDA-approved drug, colchicine, which targets the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway and subsequently modulates interleukin-1 beta signalling, will be investigated for its potential to suppress microglial-driven neuroinflammation and protect synaptic function using a combination of in vitro microglial cultures and in vivo validation in the APP/PS1 mouse model of Alzheimer's disease.
idea.contribution: This research will contribute to the development of a new therapeutic strategy for Alzheimer's disease by repurposing colchicine, an anti-inflammatory drug originally developed for gout, to modulate cytokine signalling and mitigate neuroinflammation in the brain.
